channels.name: ARINC 429 bus (single twisted-pair, simplex)
channels.direction: unidirectional broadcast — one transmitter ↔ up to 20 receivers
channels.purpose: Shielded 78 Ω twisted-pair carrying balanced differential bipolar return-to-zero (BRZ) signaling; carries 32-bit fixed-length words.
channels.physical_realization: Two-wire shielded twisted-pair (DataA + DataB); ±10 V differential drive; receiver thresholds ±2.5 V; common-mode rejection ≥ 6.5 V; supports up to 20 high-impedance differential receivers.

logical_signal_states.name: HI
logical_signal_states.rule: First half of bit-time for a logical 1; receiver decodes as HI if differential > +2.5 V.

logical_signal_states.name: LO
logical_signal_states.rule: First half of bit-time for a logical 0; receiver decodes as LO if differential < -2.5 V.

logical_signal_states.name: NULL
logical_signal_states.rule: Second half of every bit-time; inter-word gap (≥ 4 bit-times); idle. Receiver decodes as NULL if -2.5 V ≤ differential ≤ +2.5 V.

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: LABEL
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 8 bits (bits 1-8); octal label; MSB-first within label field

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: DATA
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 19 bits (bits 11-29); BNR / BCD / Discrete; mixed permitted

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: BNR_SIGN
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit (bit 29 within Data field; BNR-encoded labels only)

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: SSM
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 2 bits (bits 30-31); Sign/Status Matrix per data representation

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: INTER_WORD_GAP
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: ≥ 4 bit-times of NULL state (≥ 40 µs at 100 kbit/s)

dependency_graph.common_rule: Single shared broadcast channel: all up-to-20 receivers see every bit. BRZ encoding makes each bit self-clocking; mid-bit return-to-zero is the clock-recovery edge.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Receiver samples each bit during the first half (HI/LO) and confirms NULL during the second half. Parity bit (bit 32) closes the integrity over bits 1..31. SSM (bits 30-31) decode requires knowing the per-label data representation.
dependency_graph.framing_dependency: Implicit; inter-word gap = ≥ 4 bit-times NULL is the only word delimiter.

handshake_pairs.name: NONE
handshake_pairs.rule: ARINC 429 has no per-word handshake. The transmitter broadcasts continuously; receivers are passive monitors with no upstream feedback path.

handshake_pairs.name: PERIODIC_RETRANSMIT
handshake_pairs.rule: Each label is sent at its fixed periodic update rate per equipment-type spec; this is the recovery mechanism for corrupted or missing words (no protocol-level NACK).

ordering_rules.within_a_word: Bit 1 first → Bit 32 last on the wire.
ordering_rules.within_label_field: MSB-first (Label bit 1 in MSB-1 numbering is the LSB of the label octal; Label bit 8 is the MSB).
ordering_rules.within_data_field: Per the per-label data definition; numerically, Bit 29 is the MSB of BNR/BCD numeric data when illustrated with Bit 32 on the left.
ordering_rules.global_ordering: Multiple labels from one transmitter are interleaved on the bus per their periodic update schedules; no priority arbitration.
